summary: The root خوض (khawd) primarily means to wade or pass through water. Tropically, it extends to entering into or plunging through various things, like discourse, affairs, or even false speech.
lane: 1 خَاضَ المَآءَ خاض المآء , aor. يَخُوضُ , inf. n. خَوْضٌ (S, A, Msb, K) and خِيَاضٌ , (S, A, K,) [ He waded, or forded, through the water; ] he passed through the water walking or riding: (S:) or he entered into the water; (A, K;) as also , (K,) inf. n. تَخْوِيضٌ ; (TA;) [or this latter has an intensive signification, as it is said to have in a phrase below;] and : (K:) or he walked in, or through, the water; (Msb;) as also : (TA:) or he entered into the water and walked in it, or through it. (TA.) You say also, خَاضَ بِالفَرَسِ , meaning He brought the horse to the water; as also , (K,) inf. n. إِخَاضَهُ ; (AZ;) and , (K,) or خاوضهُ فِى المَآءِ , inf. n. مُخَاوَضَةٌ , as in the A: (TA:) or المَآءَ signifies خَاضُوهُ بِدَوَابِّهِمْ [ They waded or forded through the water, or entered into it, &c., with their beasts ]: and you say also, فى المَآءِ [ I waded or forded with them through the water; &c.; meaning with men, not with beasts]: (so I find in a copy of the A:) and القَوْمُ signifies خَاضَتْ خَيْلُهُمُ المَآءَ [ The people's horses waded or forded through the water ]. (S.) -b2- خَاضَتِ الإِبِلُ لُجَّ السَّرَابِ (tropical:) [ The camels passed through the great expanse of mirage ]. (A.) -b3- خَاضَ البَرْقُ الظَّلَامَ (tropical:) [ The lightning penetrated through the darkness ]. (A, TA.) -b4- خَاضَ إِلَيْهِ الرِّمَاحَ حَتَّى أَخَذَهُ (tropical:) [ He forced his way to him through the spears until he took him, or it ]. (A, TA. *) -b5- خَاضَ القَوْمُ فِى الحَدِيثِ , (S, A,) and فِيهِ , (S, A, K,) (tropical:) The people, or company of men, entered [or waded ] together into discourse. (S, A, K.) -b6- خَاضَ الغَمَرَاتِ , (S, K,) aor. as above, inf. n. خَوْضٌ , (TA,) (tropical:) He plunged into the submerging floods of ignorance, or the like; syn. اِقْتَحَمَهَا . (S, K, TA.) -b7- خَاضَ فِى الأَمْرِ (assumed tropical:) He entered [or plunged ] into the affair. (Msb.) -b8- In like manner you say, [ خَاضَ فِى البَاطِلِ and] البَاطِلَ (assumed tropical:) He entered [or plunged ] into false, or vain, discourse or speech: (Msb:) and خَاضَ , alone, signifies (tropical:) He said, or spoke, what was false. (A.) It is said in the Kur [lxxiv. 46], (TA,) وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الخَائِضِينَ , i. e. فِى البَاطِلِ (tropical:) [ And we used to enter into false, or vain, discourse or speech, with those who entered thereinto ]; (Bd, Jel, K;) syn. نَشْرَعُ : (Bd:) or and we used to follow the erring, &c. (O, K.) And again, [lii. 12,] الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ (tropical:) [ Who amuse themselves in entering into false, or vain, discourse or speech ]; (TA;) فى الباطل being here, again, understood. (Bd.) And again, [ix. 70,] وَخُضْتُمْ كَٱلَّذِى خَاضُوا , i. e. كَخَوْضِهِمْ (tropical:) [ And ye have entered into false, or vain, discourse or speech, like their entering thereinto ]. (K.) And again, [vi. 67,] الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِى آيَاتِنَا (tropical:) [ Who enter into false, or vain, discourse or speech respecting our signs; meaning the Kur-án]. (TA.) خَاضَ فِيهِ is also explained as signifying (assumed tropical:) He said what was false respecting it. (TA.) And خَوْضٌ signifies (assumed tropical:) The confusing, or confounding, in an affair. (TA.) -b9- خَاضَ , (S, A, Mgh, K,) and , (A, TA,) also signify He mixed, (S, * K, TA,) and stirred about, (TA,) the beverage, or wine: (S, K, TA:) or he stirred about the سَوِيق with the مِخْوَض . (A, Mgh. *) -b10- خَاضَهُ بِالسَّيْفِ (tropical:) He moved about the sword in him, having smitten him: (S, K, * TA:) or he put [or thrust ] the sword into the lower part of his belly, and then raised it upwards. (A, * TA.) -b11- خُضْتُ بِقِدْحٍ فِى القِدَاحِ , (A, TA,) inf. n. خِيَاضٌ ; and القِدَاحَ , inf. n. خِوَاضٌ ; (TA;) (tropical:) I put an arrow, (A, TA,) which I had borrowed, and by which I expected to have good luck, (TA,) among the [ other ] arrows (A, TA) used in the game called el-meysir: (TA:) see an ex. (a verse of Sakhr-el-Gheí) in art. خض .

headwords.def: خَاضَ المَآءَ خاض المآء, aor. يَخُوضُ, inf. n. خَوْضٌ (S, A, Msb, K) and خِيَاضٌ, (S, A, K,) [ He waded, or forded, through the water; ] he passed through the water walking or riding: (S:) or he entered into the water; (A, K;) as also, (K,) inf. n. تَخْوِيضٌ; (TA;) [or this latter has an intensive signification, as it is said to have in a phrase below;] and: (K:) or he walked in, or through, the water; (Msb;) as also: (TA:) or he entered into the water and walked in it, or through it.

خَوَّضَ see 1, first signification: and again in the latter part of the paragraph. خَوَّضَ فِى نَجِيعِهِ [app. meaning He wallowed in his effused blood ] is with teshdeed to render the signification intensive. (S.)
خَاْوَضَ see 1, second sentence, in two places: and again in the last sentence.

أَخَضْتُ فِى المَآءِ دابَّتِى [ I made my beast to wade, or ford, through the water ]. (S, A. *) اخاض القَوْمُ خَيْلَهُمُ المَآءَ [ The people, or company of men, made their horses to wade, or ford, through the water ] is said when they wade, or ford, with their horses through the water. (TA.) اخاض القَوْمُ: and اخاضوا المَآءَ: [which are evidently elliptical phrases:] and اخاض الفَرَسَ: see 1, second sentence. اخاض البَاطِلَ: see 1.

تَخَوَّضَ see 1, first sentence. تخوّض also signifies He constrained himself to wade, or ford, in, or through, water. (K, * TA.) This is the primary signification: and hence, تخوّض فِى الأَمْرِ (tropical:) He employed, or occupied, himself in the affair: and he used art or artifice or cunning, or his own judgment or discretion, in the affair, or in the disposal or management thereof: and so in the phrase تخوّض فى المَالِ: or, accord.
تَخَاْوَضَ see 1, near the middle of the paragraph.

مِخْوَضٌ مخوض [The instrument with which beverage, or wine, is mixed and stirred about ]; it is, for beverage, or wine, like the مِجْدَح for سَوِيق: (S, K:) or the instrument with which سويق is stirred about. (A, Mgh.)

مَخَاضَةٌ مخاض مخاضه مخاضة [ A ford; i. e.] a place where people pass through water, walking or riding: (S, A, K:) or a place where one walks through water: (Msb:) pl., (S, K,) [or this is rather a coll. gen. n.,] or مَخَائِضُ, (as in one copy of the S,) and مَخَاوِضُ (AZ, S, K) and مَخَاضَاتٌ. (Msb, TA.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
